༄༅/ /gu ru'i bdud rtsi bum chung zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// gu ru'i bdud rtsi bum chung zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐/ o rgyan padma 'byung gnas la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal pos zhus pa/ snyigs ma'i dus su rims nad 'byung ba'i rgyu ci lags/ ngo bo gang lags/ bcos thabs du yod ces zhus pas/ gu rus bka' bstsal pa/ rgyal pos zhus pa legs so// bskal pa dus kyi snyigs ma la/ gnyan nad bdun drug ma bya bas/ 'dzam gling mi yi bzhi cha phyags mas bdas bzhin 'chi ba yin nges pas/ de la bcos thabs shin tu gces pas/ mnga' bdag gi thugs la zhog khong lhog nag po gnyan gyi nad/ 'di la gnas ni nam mkha' la gnas/ mi la babs na nad rigs bzhi yod/ don gcig las med/ gnyan nad yin/ 'di la babs sa bzhi yod/ nad gzhi gang yod par 'bab// ming ni srin bu par pa ta bya ba yin/ rgyu ni gdon gyis byed/ 'jug ni ba spu'i bu ga dang sna nas 'jug /bcos thabs bzhi yod/ sman gcig las med/ sman gta' bzhi yod/ nad rigs mang po yong*/ lha rje dang nad g.yog kun la 'go /srung mtshams ni yug sa pho dang mo gnyis nyi ma rgas nas mi gtong*/ nad 'di la nag po gsum sgril bya/ tshe zad pa dang ma zad pa med/ na so dag la'ang rgan gzhon med/ mar la spu gri'i so dang 'dra/ grong khyer thams cad stong par 'gyur/ 'di la gtsug tor 'don/ rnam rgyal gyi 'khor lo 'dogs/ rdzas kyis byug /sngags bzla/ phag rgod kyi 'khor lo 'dogs/ sman pas rtog med mtshon cha'i 'khor lo 'dogs so// rdzas sngags bzlas/ nad pa'i mgo byang du bstan/ nad phog nas zhag gsum tshun chad la sman thon na sos so// nad bzhi ka'i sman gla rtsi yin/ sman gta' bzhi ni/ ba ra 'bri mdzo bzhi'i 'o ma dang/ bu ram/ ra dkar mo'i khrag /chang dang bzhi yin/ 'jang yul gyi bshal nad zhes zer/ ma mo'i rims nad zhes kyang zer/ mgo la babs na glad gzer/ nywa la babs na nywa log /ro stod la babs na gzer thung yas babs su yong*/ rgal tshigs dang brgyud pa la babs na 'dzum bu ltag dgye zer/

lhog pa nag po rgyu khol yang zer/ 'di la bzang sman mang po btang pas kho'i rogs su 'gro/ gnad la babs pas yun ring bcos longs med/ nad gzhi gang yod thog tu 'bab gso dka' bas srog la rgol/ dri chu bsdams na byi khung kha shar bstan pa'i sa blangs nas dugs bya/ khong du gla rtsi dang sman gtong*/ ra lpags kyi steng du gan rkyal du nyal lo/ ༈ /yang srog rtsa la babs na rtags 'di yong*/ rdo rgyab pa bzhin yong*/ skabs su na zhing skabs su ci yang min zer bar shed phyung par 'gro/ mar la bshal yong*/ lus dgye bor 'gro/ rngul 'byung*/ yar la skyug yong*/ so gtsigs mdangs 'chor/ lus drod che chung gnyis ka 'ong*/ khrag nag po 'khru skyug byung na sos mi srid/ zhag bdun tshun chad la 'chi nges so/ srog rtsa la zhugs pa'i rtags yin no// de'i bcos thabs la phur mo nag po bskol la grangs su bcug /de la gla rtsi dang shu dag btab la yog tshad blud/ gla rtsi dang shu dag nag po dang spang spos kyis byug pa bya/ dri chu dang srad nag dang lha khang gyo mo'i dugs bya/ 'di dang su mgyogs yin/ 'jigs dngangs dang ngu rgod byed do/ rtsa la sdod yong*/ ༈ nad 'di mchin pa la zug na rtags 'di yong*/ mgo na so la dreg pa chags/ kha skom dang kha mi bde/ rngul chu bzhin 'bab/ nyal 'dug gang byas kyang mi bzod/ mchin pa'i rtsa 'bur la 'dril/ zhag lnga la lhag par na/ drug la na na bdun la sna khrag shor nas gza' rgyab pa bzhin song nas gnad gcod med par shed chung nyal song nas 'jam nyal te 'chi/ nad 'di'i chu mdog ni dmar po dang*/ ser po dang*/ nag po gang yang yong*/ mkhun pa che chung gnyis ga yong*/ mchin pa'i rtsa ni 'bur la 'dril/ tshad pa che/ de mchin pa la zug pa'i rtags yin/ de bcos pa'i thabs la phur mong la gla rtsi btab la grang thang btang*/ bu ram dang sbyar la btang*/ rngul byung na chu grang blud/ rjes la srin bshal gyi sbyong btang ngo*/

mgo na ba la ba sha ka dang pi pi ling rdog po bdun dang*/ go snyod a ru ra rnams gdus pa'i khu ba ga bur dang sbyar la gtang ngo*// mchin pa ma zhu na sman btang na sos yong*/ yang gla rtsi dang gi wang gnyis phur mong gi thang gis 'phul/ 'di rang gi gnyen po ma shes na sman bzang po btang yang don med 'gyur ro/ ༈ /nad 'di mkhal ma la zug na/ rtags ni skyigs bu 'ong lus la thor pa yong glang thabs su ldang*/ rkang lag na ba dang*/ bshal ba dang*/ rtsa sngon chu dmar grang shum byed/ rkang lag gyong pa kha sdong 'phrig pa/ mig gyen du ldog nas drang por blta mi shes pa dang*/ rtsibs thung gzer ba dang*/ spyi mig na ba dang*/ gzer mig tu na ba yong*/ nad mkhal tshil la zhugs nas drod chung pa na zhag gsum nas 'chi/ de bcos thabs la/ phur mang skol ba thun re gtang*/ gla rtsi dang pi pi ling dang*/ sga skya de rnams khong du btang*/ phag sha nya sha rnams btsos la btang*/ lung thang rtse ma ru rtse byi tang ka de rnams ril bu byas mar dkar gyis bstums la khong du btang*/ dugs rigs thams cad bya/ mkhan pa 'bru mar 'ba' cha sga skya rnams kyi dugs sha la ras srab mo blan la tshugs tshad bya/ ༈ nad 'di long la zug na rtags 'di yong*/ lus la srin khros pas 'bor 'bor po dang rong rong yong*/ kha skam mig khro tshugs su blta/ rgyu smad lte ba'i 'og tu na/ dri chu bsdam/ rkang lag reng*/ lus kyi ba spu gyen la ldog /thed po kyang reng*/ brang la thor pa 'byung*/ skad mi thon/ lus rngul zag pa khrag tu 'ong*/ skabs su 'khru ba 'ongs/ rgyu long la babs pa'i rtags so// de bcos thabs la/ phur mong sla nga'i nang du rdza phor kha sbub tha ma 'dam pas bskor te du ba mi 'chor ba byas nas bsregs pa'i thal ba dang*/ srin sman tshogs tshad ril bu byas nas mar gsar gyis bstums nas phur mong gi grang thang gis phul la btang ngo*// gla rtsi chang dang sbyar ba yang btang ngo*// nad 'di mi sos pa'i rtags bzhi yod/

skad chad na mi sos/ bshang lam nas khrag nag po byung na mi sos/ ro stod dgyes na mi sos/ 'dar cing sna gnyer na 'chi/ gzab la ngos zin pa gal che'o/ mnga' bdag gi thugs la de ltar zhog ༈ /nad 'di 'byung ba'i rgyu ni/ bla ma'i bka' bcag pa/ sngags pas dam tshig nyams pa/ btsun pa mang po'i dge 'dun sde 'khrug na 'ong*/ ༈ srung ba la 'khor lo rtsibs lnga'i dang po la 'di 'bri/ āoṃ āoṃ dhe ba nan te sad ka ru nan te sad/ rtsibs gnyis pa la/ āoṃ āoṃ bram ze bram sad/ bshog zi bshog sad/ āoṃ āoṃ zhung tshe zhung sad/ shog bi shog sad/ gsum pa la/ āoṃ gnam lcags rdo rje kha la bram/ gnam lcags rdo rje du ma bram/ bzhi pa la/ gnam lcags rdo rje thib sod/ āoṃ phe khyim ni swā hā/ lnga pa la/ āoṃ ka ru na tsa le hūm̐ phaṭa/ rtog med kyi 'khor lo rdzogs so/ ༈ /lte ba la/ khrom/ mthar pho 'khor la oṃ ga ru ḍa haṃ sa he tsa le tsa le swā hā/ dang*/ mo 'khor la oṃ phe khyim swā hā/ de mthar spel tshig dang bcas pa bri/ rtsibs mchan dang po la/ tadya thā/ i li gi wa su li i gi swā hā/ gnyis pa la/ tadya thā ha ga ma ha ma ha li/ ha ma ha ma swā hā/ gsum pa la/ tadya thā bdag la badzra ghandhe kan tsa dur mi e ge he/ bzhi pa la/ kan de hi kandhe tsa dur mi li i gi hi/ lnga pa la/ ga na hu ni ārya swā hā/ de rgyab mu khyud la yi dam sngags sham ā li kā li ye dhar spel tshig bcas bri/ 'bri ba'i rdzas ni/ btsan dug shu dag gu gul shing kun ldong ros gla rtsi ba bla snag tshwa dang bsres la phag pa gnyis bri/ gcig gi sngags mgo nang du bstan pa bri/ gcig phyir la bstan pa bri/ kha sbyor byas 'dogs so// dge'o// bkra shis// maṅga laṃ/// /
